unit.why: A collection of homilies and sayings on marriage from several masters (Mezhbizh, Ziditshov/R. Dov Ber, R. Bunem, Gostynin, Ger) and a halakhic custom; the only quasi-events, a remark told to the author and a teaching given to a groom, frame sayings rather than form a narrative.
unit.boundary_note: division is one numbered section (ה) of a thematic chapter 'מענין נשואין'; it ends with the heading of the next section 'מענין נשמת'
